# Imported data: sources, versions and licences

Everything here is generated by `npm run data:import` from the files `npm run data:fetch` downloads
into `vendor-src/` (not committed). Nothing is fetched at runtime. The app's About page credits each
source.

**Licence of these files.** `jmdict.json`, `kanji.json` and `pitch.json` are derived from CC BY-SA 4.0
data and are shared under **CC BY-SA 4.0**. `jlpt-words.json` combines the JLPT lists (below) with
nothing else. The stroke files in `public/strokes/` are derived from KanjiVG and shared under
**CC BY-SA 3.0**.

| File | Source | Version | Licence | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jmdict.json` | [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/jmdict/j_jmdict.html) (EDRDG), `JMdict_e.gz` | downloaded 2026-10-18 | CC BY-SA 4.0 ([EDRDG licence](https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html)) | Reading and word-type checks: common entries (news1, ichi1, spec1/2, gai1) plus every entry spelled like a JLPT word |
| `kanji.json` | [KANJIDIC2](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/KANJIDIC_Project) (EDRDG) | downloaded 2026-10-18 | CC BY-SA 4.0 | On and kun readings, meanings, stroke counts, grades, jōyō flag; jōyō and JLPT kanji only |
| `kanji.json` (`jlpt` field) | [kanji-data](https://github.com/davidluzgouveia/kanji-data) `jlpt_new`, from Jonathan Waller's [JLPT resources](http://www.tanos.co.uk/jlpt/) | master, 2026-10-18 | repo MIT; lists CC BY (tanos.co.uk) | The kanji's estimated JLPT level (N5–N1). Only this field is used: the repo's WaniKani fields are not openly licensed and are dropped |
| `jlpt-words.json` | [open-anki-jlpt-decks](https://github.com/jamsinclair/open-anki-jlpt-decks) `src/n5–n1.csv`, from Jonathan Waller's lists | main, 2026-10-18 | MIT; lists CC BY (tanos.co.uk) | Word lists per level (**estimates**: JLPT has published none since 2010). The easiest level a word appears in wins. Ids `w-<level>-<sha1(ja+kana) first 8>` are permanent |
| `pitch.json` | [Kanjium](https://github.com/mifunetoshiro/kanjium) `accents.txt` (pitch notation by Uros O.) | master, 2026-10-18 | CC BY-SA 4.0 | Tokyo accent numbers (`"ja\|kana": [n…]`) for the words kept in `jmdict.json`. Missing pitch shows nothing |
| `public/strokes/*.json` | [KanjiVG](https://kanjivg.tagaini.net/) `kanjivg-20260714-main.zip` | r20260714 | CC BY-SA 3.0 | Stroke order, centrelines and stroke types (`kvg:type`) for every kana and the kanji used, base files only (no Kaisho or regional variants). Medians are sampled from the centrelines. `npm run strokes:extract`; run by hand and committed. `tests/fixtures/kanjivg/*.svg` are unmodified copies of 40 KanjiVG files (with their licence header) for the stroke tests |

## Counts (2026-10-18 import)

Words: N5 718, N4 668, N3 2,140, N2 1,809, N1 2,699. Kanji: 2,383 (N5 79, N4 166, N3 367, N2 367,
N1 1,232; the rest jōyō without a JLPT level). JMdict: 31,236 entries. Pitch: 34,838 words.

## Spot checks (by Claude, 2026-10-18)

- Readings: 食べる たべる (v1), 先生 せんせい, 行く いく (alt ゆく), 今日 きょう (N5) and こんにち (N3).
- Pitch against the Tokyo standard: 箸 はし 1 and 橋 はし 2; 雨 あめ 1 and 飴 あめ 0; お茶 0.
- Kanji: 必 N3, 5 strokes; 右 and 左 N5, 5 strokes; 生 on セイ・ショウ, kun い.きる・う.まれる.
- 56 list entries keep non-kana notation (affixes like お～, and one slip: いただく listed with 頂く as
  its reading). `data:check` reports them as warnings; lessons never take readings from this list.

**Still needed (human task H3):** confirm the JLPT list source, and have a teacher spot-check 50
entries per level.
